# 📢 NH Reader v0.7.0 — Custom Title Bar, Reader Ergonomics, Arabic RTL Polish & Multi-Platform Portability

**Release Date:** 2026-10-01  
**Tag:** [`v0.7.0`](https://github.com/HELIX-Origin/NH-Reader/releases/tag/v0.7.0)

We are thrilled to announce **NH Reader v0.7.0**, our most comprehensive multi-platform and ergonomics upgrade yet! This major update brings a beautifully integrated custom title bar with per-OS tailored window controls and positioning preferences, restores seamless system tray integration with minimize-to-tray on close, adds configurable reader preload buffering, an image quality selector, and direct CBZ export straight from the reader toolbar.

In addition, v0.7.0 delivers all 17 community language packs with 100% key parity (279/279 keys) and full Arabic RTL layout polish, standalone portable archives for Windows, macOS, and Linux with universal launcher scripts, in-repo documentation with live translation, and a rock-solid CI packaging workflow featuring dedicated per-architecture Android split APKs and true dry-run verification.

---

## 🌟 What's New in v0.7.0

### 🖥️ Integrated Custom Title Bar & Per-OS Window Controls
- **Custom Integrated Title Bar** — Disabled native OS window decorations in favor of an integrated, seamless dark title bar spanning the entire desktop shell.
- **Per-OS Native Controls (`WindowControls.svelte`)** — Window controls dynamically tailor their layout and styling to the host operating system:
  - **macOS:** Renders unframed native traffic lights on the left side that reveal inner glyphs on hover.
  - **Windows & Linux:** Renders compact 24×22px buttons enclosed within a subtle 5px squircle frame (`border: 1px solid var(--border)`, `border-radius: 5px`) with crisp minimize (dash), maximize/restore (square/stacked), and close (cross) vector glyphs.
  - **Theme Preservation:** Highlight and hover states respect custom Linux desktop themes without overriding system theme colors.
- **Customizable Window Controls Position** — Added `windowControlsPosition` setting (`Auto`, `Left`, `Right`) under Appearance in Settings, empowering Linux users and custom window manager enthusiasts to position buttons according to their environment conventions.
- **Restored System Tray & Minimize-to-Tray on Close** — Closing the application window now cleanly minimizes the app to the system tray, keeping downloads and background services running without disruption, while retaining full termination via the tray menu "Quit" action.
- **Window Dragging & Maximize Toggle** — Fully interactive title bar with native window dragging across empty spaces and double-click to toggle maximize/restore.

### 📖 Reader Ergonomics: Preload Buffering, Quality Selector & Direct CBZ Export
- **Configurable Preload Distance** — Added reader preload distance options (`1`, `2`, `3`, `5` pages) dynamically sizing reader slice buffering ahead and behind to provide instant page transitions and eliminate loading pauses.
- **Image Quality Selector** — Toggle between `Original (High)` (full-resolution streaming from `IMAGE_HOST`) and `Data Saver (Fast)` (compressed preview thumbnails from `THUMB_HOST` to conserve metered bandwidth and accelerate slow connections).
- **Direct CBZ Export from Reader Toolbar** — Added a dedicated CBZ export button directly in the reader toolbar (with `E` keyboard shortcut) that queues background packaging via `enqueueDownload(id, 'cbz')`, complete with real-time percentage progress and completion checkmark indicator.
- **Quick Keyboard Shortcuts** — Press `Q` to cycle image quality, `E` to export CBZ, `F` to cycle fit mode, and `R` to toggle manga reading order (LTR / RTL).

### 🌐 Complete 17 Language Packs, Arabic RTL Polish & In-Page Live Translation
- **All 17 Language Packs at 100% Parity** — Complete hand-rolled translations for Japanese (`ja`), Simplified Chinese (`zh-CN`), Traditional Chinese (`zh-TW`), Korean (`ko`), Spanish (`es`), French (`fr`), German (`de`), Russian (`ru`), Portuguese (`pt`), Italian (`it`), Thai (`th`), Vietnamese (`vi`), Indonesian (`id`), Polish (`pl`), Dutch (`nl`), Turkish (`tr`), and Arabic (`ar`). All 18 packs achieve 100% key parity (279/279 keys) validated with `npm run i18n:check`.
- **Arabic RTL Layout Polish (M9.2 RTL Phase)** — Added `isRTL` and `dir` getters to `locale.svelte.ts`, document-level `dir="rtl"` reactivity, Arabic typography font fallbacks (`Segoe UI Arabic`, `Noto Sans Arabic`, `Tahoma`) with ergonomic 1.6 line height, mirrored drawer animations (`nh-drawer-slide-rtl`), mirrored toggle switch knobs, and RTL search alignments.
- **Per-Locale Date and Number Formatting** — Upgraded `format.ts` to use browser standard `Intl.NumberFormat`, `Intl.DateTimeFormat`, and `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat`, dynamically linked to active locale.
- **Documentation Migration to `docs/` with Live Translation Dropdown** — Moved documentation from GitHub Wiki into repository `docs/` folder (`docs/README.md`). Added interactive in-page Google Translate dropdown widget (`docs/translate.js`) supporting all 18 languages, and replaced external sidebar/footer with in-page breadcrumbs and index footers.

### 📦 Multi-Platform Portability & CI Packaging with Android Split APKs
- **Standalone Multi-Platform Portable Packages** — Implemented standalone portable packages (`NHReaderPortable_Windows_x64.zip`, `nh-reader_portable_linux_x86_64.tar.gz`, `NHReaderPortable_macOS.zip`) sharing root `.portable` marker and isolated `./data/` folder, with ancestor traversal in `src-tauri/src/lib.rs`.
- **Universal Portable Launcher Scripts** — Added standalone launcher scripts `scripts/launch-linux.sh`, `scripts/launch-macos.command`, and `scripts/launch-windows.bat`.
- **Decoupled Downstream Release Publishing** — Decoupled asset publishing from build runners into a dedicated downstream `publish-release` job, eliminating race conditions on release creation and ensuring that failed builds never produce partial releases.
- **Dedicated Android Split APKs** — Added dedicated `package-android` job in CI building separate APK files for each supported Android architecture (`aarch64` / arm64-v8a, `armv7` / armeabi-v7a, `x86_64`) via `--apk --split-per-abi`, excluding universal APKs to minimize file size.
- **True Dry Run Mode & Test Pre-Release** — Added true dry-run mode via `workflow_dispatch` input (`dry_run: true`) to validate and verify all packages without publishing to GitHub releases, alongside optional draft pre-release creation (`create_test_release: true`) for testing asset uploads safely.
- **Per-Platform Tauri Configs & Node.js 26 Upgrade** — Added `tauri.<platform>.conf.json` platform configurations and upgraded CI packaging workflow to Node.js 26.
- **NSIS Theme & Contrast Alignment** — Configured coordinated text and background colors in `src-tauri/windows/hooks.nsh` to eliminate black-on-dark unreadable text and preserve dark DWM title bars.
- **Official App Icon Installer Bitmaps** — Generated crisp 150×57 `header.bmp` and 164×314 `sidebar.bmp` assets directly from `icon.png` via `scripts/generate-installer-bitmaps.ps1`.

## 📦 Distribution & Available Packages

Download the package for your platform from the [GitHub Release](https://github.com/HELIX-Origin/NH-Reader/releases/tag/v0.7.0):

- **Windows:** NSIS Installer (`NH Reader_0.7.0_x64-setup.exe`), WiX MSI (`NH Reader_0.7.0_x64_en-US.msi`), and Portable ZIP (`NHReaderPortable_Windows_x64.zip`).
- **Linux:** Debian package (`nh-reader_0.7.0_amd64.deb`), AppImage (`nh-reader_0.7.0_amd64.AppImage`), and Portable Tarball (`nh-reader_portable_linux_x86_64.tar.gz`).
- **macOS:** DMG Disk Image (`NH Reader_0.7.0_x64.dmg`) and Portable ZIP (`NHReaderPortable_macOS.zip`).
- **Android:** Split APKs for ARM64 (`nh-reader_0.7.0_arm64-v8a.apk`), ARMv7 (`nh-reader_0.7.0_armeabi-v7a.apk`), and x86_64 (`nh-reader_0.7.0_x86_64.apk`) *(community-supported / untested)*.

Upgrade in place: run the new installer over your existing installation. Your local database (`database.sqlite`), favorites, reading history, downloaded archives, and settings carry over automatically.
